why: The local transcription path exists so the pipeline runs with no paid credentials. Whether it costs measurement quality is a question about evidence, not about intent, so it was measured before the model and the decoding options were chosen.

recordings.solo: audio/solo, 141 seconds, one speaker, contains disfluencies

reference.what_it_is: the AssemblyAI transcript of the same audio
reference.what_it_is_not: truth. Neither transcriber is a reference standard, and no expert verbatim transcript of these recordings exists. Every figure below is agreement between two systems, which this project does not treat as evidence of correctness.

model_and_prompt_trials_on_the_solo_reco.what_decided_it: Disfluency retention is set by the decoding prompt, not by model size. Unprimed, both models returned zero of the reference's five filled pauses; primed, both returned all five. The large model cost five times the runtime and a three gigabyte download for a word agreement difference of about half a percentage point.
model_and_prompt_trials_on_the_solo_reco.timings_caveat: single runs on one machine, not a benchmark. The primed small run being faster than the unprimed one is model caching, not a real speedup.
